_note: Termijnagenda (long-term agenda / LTA) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the planned-agenda-item register, the per-body board page (REQ-LTA-005, reached from the index's Board header action rather than a menu entry so the menu counts ADR-004 holds stay put; custom PlannedAgendaBoard: period columns, drag-to-reschedule and a keyboard Reschedule action, both through PlannedAgendaRescheduleDialog) and, on the detail page, the PlannedAgendaActionsTab widget (reschedule / realise / lapse dialogs, REQ-LTA-004/006/003). The Dashboard 'Long-term agenda overdue' widget (REQ-LTA-010) lives in the base src/manifest.json (design D6: mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale).

config._note: Termijnagenda index (REQ-LTA-007). Columns onderwerp/governanceBody/plannedPeriod/expectedType/ownerType/lifecycle; quick filters on lifecycle (expectedType, governanceBody and plannedPeriod are facetable and available via the index sidebar facets). CSV export via the shared ExportService + CnMassExportDialog. The overdue-KPI deep-link (deferred Dashboard widget, design D6) targets this page pre-filtered to non-terminal lifecycle.

pages.title: Long-term agenda board
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/termijnagenda/specs/termijnagenda-register/spec.md#requirement-req-lta-005-per-body-board-view-with-drag-to-reschedule. Design D5 fallback: the shared board component binds lanes to an enum, not to a value-derived period axis, so the board is a custom page. Columns are the body's distinct planned periods plus two empty quarters, ordered by each period's last day (src/utils/plannedAgenda.js).

config._note: TermijnagendaDetail (REQ-LTA-006/007). Plan data leads 8-wide, publication stacked right; governanceBody/owner and the origin links (originToezegging/originMotie/originDecision) and realisation links (realisedAgendaItem/realisedDecision) render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets. verschuifHistorie (shift history) renders in the data widget as an embedded array. Files leaf for a startnotitie. Audit trail is a sidebar tab. Execution narrative for a linked motion stays on that motion's UitvoeringsUpdate log — never duplicated here (REQ-LTA-006).

widgets.title: Actions
widgets._note: REQ-LTA-004/006/003: Reschedule (mandatory reason, appends a shift-history entry), Mark as realised (links the agenda item or decision of the same body that realised it; creates nothing), Mark as lapsed (mandatory reason). Hidden once the item is final.
